bounded_repairs.allowed: Exact construction/runtime API repair only without threshold relaxation; physical parameter changes require distinct config hash and three new gates. Preserve initial failures.

collision_scope: All actual 200 Hz PhysX states; no continuous-time or real-world guarantee. Native outer-envelope separation suffices; outer-envelope overlap is NOT_VERIFIED, never proof of actual penetration.

physics_gate_reuse: Exact scene physical hash, three gate seeds and original summaries unchanged; existing gate free-node velocity amplitude .002m/s exceeds revised G1 .001m/s. Robot reset perturbations require new EMPTY controls, not a claim of material validation.

predecessor_pilot_snapshot.reason: G1 seeds did not explicitly randomize state; old G1 lacks synchronized body collider poses/nonpenetration evidence. Preserve raw labels as historical diagnostics, exclude from primary metrics.

primary_admission: V5-only explicit seeded reset, complete actual 200 Hz step chain, native exact/conservative-separation geometry audit, real phase ledger, and discrete action tube. Unsupported evidence excluded even from response fitting.

prior_pilots.reason: Old pilots have neither the revised action contract nor complete primary evidence; original raw is retained and every launch consumes budget.

revision_reason: Explicit discrete action contract, actual 200 Hz geometry/phase evidence, and native exact/conservative-separation audit before primary collection.
